reviews.text: I was very nervous going to get my cat spayed because I wasn’t really informed and when I went to go drop off and picked up my two kittens I was met with education and patience. And I felt really comfortable knowing that they were in good hands. Staff was very nice and made me and my cats feel welcome.

We just wanted to let you know that we are very happy with the surgery our cat Victor had.
He's already home. It's been three days since the operation, and he's doing great. He hasn't had any discomfort or anything. Besides, this is the third time they've helped us with our cats' neutering surgery, and we definitely recommend them. They do excellent work, and the staff there provide outstanding customer service and treat the pets with great care and affection.
Very friendly.  We have spayed all of our cats here.

Took my puppy here for her surgery. She got a cornea ulcer two days before her surgery, and they were beyond accommodating. I came early to speak to the vet, and they were able to go ahead with the surgery. The vet gave her extra eye drops during the procedure. She came out as bouncy as she came in! My puppy healed perfectly afterwards.

Tree House Humane Society made my dog’s spay surgery an incredibly smooth and very affordable experience. The staff was professional, kind, and reassuring from start to finish. Communication was clear at every step, and the post‑surgery instructions were easy to follow. I’m grateful for their care and highly recommend their services. Very affordable as well.
Thank you!
Everything Very Good
Easy affordable and took great care of my kitten!

Check in for his neutering was wonderful.  Check out was too.  Nurse who explained was great. He had no reaction ate like normal and it was hard to keep him from playing.
I see the tattoo, but he did not seem to notice any pain.  Appreciate being able to buy more flea and tick treatment from you.
We decided to keep our orphan, “Squeaky”. Wish you had a regular vet service we could take him too. 😻

The staff was great and answered all my questions with ease. I’ve brought all 4 of my girls as well as other foster cats in the past here for a few years now simply because I trust them and love to support the incredible vets and again all the staff!
Great

It is extremely helpful to have a place in my neighborhood where my dog can get her shots and heartworm tests. During the 15 years I had a car, it never even occurred to me that having a vet 50 minutes away would be a task for quick visits. I thought this location was only for cats until my dog just KEPT sniffing at it and standing by the door. That's when I noticed that cat face I always saw on the door (near the cat trees) suddenly had a dog next to it. My eyes lit up.

Although I still wince every single time I have to hand over the leash to a stranger (and have the option to come into exam rooms with my dog and my vet), I feel safer when I see Natalie reaching for the leash. She has ALWAYS been kind to my dog, Junee, and never has to pull on Junee's leash to follow. I also like a newer face, Sophie. Like Natalie, she tried to win over Junee, who was suddenly shy.

Past vets Isabelle Pajak and Lilly Johnson were friendly and gave me useful tips to maintain my dog's weight. I do NOT care for Mark Primiano, the vet who didn't come out once my dog had vaccinations, treated me like I was invisible but came outside for the next two dogs. The only action I saw from him was rejecting heartworm meds. I hope he's not there when I return next year.

Called on a Friday for looking for emergency pyometra and spay care a friend who couldn't afford a veterinary ER, and was put in touch with a ton of resources, Thank you for all the help from whoever I I talk to on the phone this morning, and shout out your clinic's incredibly affordable pricing for weekday operations, and for including the info on your site that the cost for pyometra care includes recovery meds and all other subcosts, most other places aren't clear about that!

The staff is warm and knowledgeable. Drop off and pickup procedure for spay/neuter is quick and efficient. I brought my second cat from over an hour away because of the expertise of this location and also the very reasonable pricing.
Awesome

I took my dog there for his shots after I couldn't afford my regular vet anymore  year ago made an appointment no problem.Now I received  countless emails for one vaccine needed in April and have called countless times only to be told no availability call back I did this at least two to three times a week and still have no appointment
They say they don't book ahead, so how is it there are no available spots? Ridiculous, I thought this would be a great place to bring my little one, however I don't know how others get their attention able to make appointments sadly bad business
I will have to pay extremely high prices at a vet  I can't  afford because,they make it impossible to schedule.

The staff at Treehouse are professional, friendly and caring people. Their facility is modern and clean. I've had several adult cats over the years, so was new to a kitten needing spay surgery. Their affordable services, pre and post-op instructions were easy and clear. They even texted me when my kitten was available to pick up earlier than scheduled. Highly recommend this quality group for affordable core services. Thank you, Tree House!
The service and experience was exceptional. The staff was very kind and professional and explained everything very well. Thank you!

Attentive staff, timely service, and affordability are what makes this place so wonderful. Scheduling isn’t the easiest, but I hold out hope that they will streamline the vet services with time. Thanks for all you do!

I can't say enough good things about Treehouse. The staff are so friendly and compassionate. They are also very patient when they are asked questions. The fact Treehouse is able to provide affordable spaying, neutering and vaccines is truly a godsend. My friend would have had to give up her cat if not for the affordability at Treehouse.  Please continue your food works so that we can have pets.
Beautiful place. I’ll be bringing all my cats here from now on.
Great experience and great communication from the staffs. I 100% recommend tree house vet to everyone
Amazing and affordable place. They were so kind and answered all my questions. I went to get my cat neutered and he is doing amazing
I have taken my dogs and kittens here and I love the staff and the treatment the animals get
Shots for my small dog they were great

Really happy with my experience here! They took care of my male kitten getting neutered, and answering all of my questions prior to the surgery, as well as after. He’s happy and healthy? And their communication was wonderful through it all. Highly recommend!

Treehouse has a TNVR- Trap, Nueter, Vaccinate and release program and it's amazing. They Saved our outdoor cat Noah from some serious health issues. If you have an outdoor cat that you care for and need to care for him, Treehouse provides traps that the outdoor cats need to arrive in and they treated Noah with all vaccines, shots for rabies, worms, clipped his ear to signify outdoor cat to not be trapped by others, microchip, collar tag and all his shots for $60. They have other vet services but the TNVR is amazing and the staff oive being there to assist. Highly recommended. ❤️

Great staff and great doctor! He helped my Monroe more than he knows. I am forever grateful, thank you so much. She is healing just fine and running around like normal (as much as I tell her to stop to heal properly lol)

Thank you
Great place to bring your Pet to get fixed. Good price
Very friendly and knowledgeable staff.
Amazing care, wonderful staff for my cats.

Tree house took such great care of my 1 year old cat Fluffy for her spay surgery. The incision was small and clean and my cat came home happy and comfortable thanks to the medication they gave her prior to her discharge. This is an experience unique to Tree House because other spay services my other cats have received had large, painful incision sites and less compassionate pain management. I’m so grateful for these services and even more grateful that they could be offered at an affordable cost.
V . Positive experience and post procedure explanation was helpful. Thanks!
Affordable, friendly. Note: they only do neuter / spay and vaccines for pets. Not a full service vet solution.
The people and officials there are great, the prices are excellent and their service is very nice.
Thanks you did great job.

I took my 2 rescue kittens here and the staff did a great job making them feel safe and getting them the care they needed! They’re now all up to date on shots as well as being spayed/neutered and they’re happy and healthy. Quality care at affordable prices. We had such a positive experience here!

Extremely disappointed with tree house vet center. Despite presenting a genuine case of a rescue cat in need, the staff were unhelpful, dismissive, and completely lacking in compassion. I expected an organization dedicated to animal welfare to be more understanding, but instead I was met with rigid responses and no real effort to help. It’s disheartening to see a rescue group turn away animals that truly need care. They may promote compassion, but unfortunately, I didn’t see any of it.
Very knowledgeable and caring staff! I’m glad I found this place instead of going to the vet who was going to charge me 4x more.
They took such good care of my baby Milan at a truly amazing price 😊 I highly recommend it...the service is top-notch 🥹 thank you all 🫶🏾❤️ …

I can't say enough good things about Tree House! I recently brought my dog here for neutering and vaccinations, and the experience was exceptional. The staff is incredibly friendly and welcoming, making both me and my pup feel at ease. After the visit, my dog was happy and healthy, which speaks volumes about the care he received.

They took the time to thoroughly explain the procedure as well as the aftercare, which I truly appreciated. The facility was impeccably clean, and I’m thrilled to report that my pup has had no issues following his surgery. Plus, the prices for the vaccinations and surgery were very reasonable.

I will absolutely be bringing my pup back to Tree House for any future needs! Highly recommend this place to any pet owner!

Tree house is absolutely awful, their job is just a paycheck for them they do not care about animals at all and they lie about their services, if you love your animals take them somewhere else these people do not care.

How dare you spay pregnant cats without the owner's consent? I understand that it’s a busy clinic and there are staffing shortages; however, that’s not a valid excuse. It only takes a minute to call the owner and ask them if they want to continue the procedure. It’s either a 'Yes' or 'No.' It’s not that hard!
great place to bring your furry family members. the staff is really friendly and they make vet visits easy.
